### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Reinspection charge (deepest prerequisite), assessed 2026-10-05, on the most recent within-tolerance inspection (2026-09-08, WSR-55906-01).**
- Base (Billing Note: Reinspection Charge on a Re-Measured Crack): test — concrete_flatwork items filed on the coverage 2 (WSR-55620-01, WSR-55906-01), within-tolerance denials 4 -> "Re-measurement of a re-reported item"; visit charge = program reinspection fee (Schedule of Homeowner Charges, Preferred: USD 100.00); charge = visit charge rounded once at the end.
- Factors: Borderline — 0.2188 vs concrete flatwork 0.25: at least 75% (0.1875), under 90% (0.225) -> 0.80. Re-measure delay — filed 2026-08-31, re-measured 2026-09-08 = 8 days -> 0.80. Soil movement — concrete flatwork in Sierra Vista Ranch -> 0.70. Settling period — 2025-09-19 to 2026-10-05 = 12 whole months -> 0.90. Repeat reinspections — one charge already assessed in the window later than 2025-10-05 (WCH-55391, 2026-03-25) -> 1.25. Shared visit (method) — on 2026-09-08 no walkthrough (eleven-month walkthrough was 2026-08-20); one covered-work entry (WSR-55841-01 inspection `defect_confirmed` 2026-09-08) -> shared between 2.
- Assembly: visit charge = 100.00 x 0.80 x 0.80 x 0.70 x 0.90 x 1.25 = 50.40; item's share 50.40 / 2 = **25.20**.
- Fall-back (base only): **100.00**.

**(b) Emergency dispatch charge (middle prerequisite), assessed 2026-10-05, latest dispatch 2026-09-19 WSR-56012-01.**
- Base (Billing Note: Amount of the Emergency Dispatch Charge): latest inspection of the dispatched item `maintenance_item` -> "Any other finding -> Dispatch chargeable"; scheduled dispatch charge = program emergency dispatch fee (Preferred USD 125.00); rounded once at the end.
- Factors: Condition class — `no_cooling` -> comfort call 0.80. Inspection finding — `maintenance_item` -> 0.75. First period — 12 whole months, no dispatch charge ever assessed on the coverage -> 0.75. Active buyer — no agreement under construction / closing scheduled (the only agreement is `closed`); a Homesite Reservation `held` with a `reservation_deposit` received 2026-09-29 (inside 12 months) -> 0.75 (reads the Homesite Reservation product's records). Non-warranty visits — reinspection + dispatch charges assessed later than 2025-10-05: WCH-55391 plus the reinspection charge written in step (a) today = 2 -> 1.50 (would be 1.25 before step (a)). Response-time proration (method) — 15.5 hours vs Preferred 12 (more than 12, not more than 24) -> prorate by 12/15.5.
- Assembly: 125.00 x 0.80 x 0.75 x 0.75 x 0.75 x 1.50 = 63.28125; x 12 / 15.5 = 48.9919... -> **48.99**.
- Fall-back (base only): **125.00**. Value if step (a) were skipped: 40.83.

**(c) Systems settlement (root, user write), settlement date 2026-10-05, WSR-55841-01.**
- Base (Claims Settlement Worksheet: Systems Settlement Amount): scheduled = cash-in-lieu maximum (Preferred USD 1000.00, from the limits schedule the worksheet names) x 0.40, rounded; never more than the maximum.
- Factors: Systems trade — hvac -> 1.25. Systems market — Sierra Vista Ranch on the purchase agreement -> 1.30. Home scale — contract price 704490 >= 700000 -> 1.20 (base price 689990 is not the measure). Maintenance record — inspections later than 2024-10-05 with maintenance/damage/alteration findings: one (2026-09-19 `maintenance_item`) -> 0.90. Remaining coverage — days from 2026-10-05 (not counted) to 2028-09-18 = 714 -> 365-729 -> 1.10. Repeated failures (method) — accepted callbacks approved under systems coverage later than 2025-10-05: one (2026-08-15, `callback_seq 1`) -> scheduled + half of (maximum - scheduled).
- Assembly: scheduled = round(1000.00 x 0.40 x 1.25 x 1.30 x 1.20 x 0.90 x 1.10) = 772.20; 772.20 + (1000.00 - 772.20)/2 = **886.10**; under the cap.
- Fall-back (base only): **400.00**.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Problems: P1 (root, customer's own write) systems-item cash settlement acceptance on WSR-55841-01; P2 emergency dispatch charge on the 2026-09-19 dispatch (WSR-56012-01); P3 reinspection charge on the 2026-09-08 re-measurement (WSR-55906-01). Dependencies: P1 waits on P2; P2 waits on P3. Order: P3, P2, P1.

Hop P1 -> P2 — **state-derived**.
- Sentence (systems hub, "Conditions of offer"): "A systems settlement is not offered to the homeowner, and no cash-in-lieu payout is approved on it, until every emergency dispatch recorded on the coverage that the dispatch charge rules make chargeable carries its emergency dispatch charge."
- Records: one `warranty_emergency_dispatched` row (2026-09-19, WSR-56012-01) with a `maintenance_item` finding and no `warranty_charge_assessed` of type `emergency_dispatch_fee`. Rules (dispatch billing note): "Any other finding -> Dispatch chargeable"; proration leaves a charge (15.5 h <= 24 h). State unmet.
- Write found with the sentence's words ("emergency dispatch", "carries its emergency dispatch charge"): "Emergency Dispatch Charge on a Calloway Limited Home Warranty Coverage": "When the dispatch finds no covered defect, the dispatch may carry an emergency dispatch charge ... Tool: `assess_emergency_dispatch_charge_91903470`". `KB_search("emergency dispatch charge")` returns it with its billing note and factors.

Hop P2 -> P3 — **state-derived**.
- Sentence (dispatch hub, "What the charge is"): "The dispatch charge is fixed only after every re-reported item that a re-measurement again found within tolerance and that the reinspection rules make chargeable carries its reinspection charge."
- Records: WSR-55906-01 re-measured 2026-09-08 `within_tolerance`, concrete flatwork items 2 and within-tolerance denials 4 -> re-measurement (chargeable); shared-visit rule leaves a positive share; no reinspection charge on WSR-55906-01. Older within-tolerance items: WSR-55377-01 already carries WCH-55391; WSR-55620-01 was a first report (only concrete flatwork item at the time) and, because the billing note works only on "the most recent inspection recorded on the coverage that found a crack within tolerance", it is not assessable today; WSR-55102-01 first drywall report. State unmet for WSR-55906-01 only.
- Write found with the sentence's words ("re-reported", "re-measurement", "within tolerance", "reinspection charge"): "Reinspection Charge on a Calloway Limited Home Warranty Coverage": "a crack item that was denied as within tolerance can be reported again; when the re-measurement of that re-reported item again finds it within tolerance, the visit may carry a reinspection charge ... Tool: `assess_reinspection_charge_a99ab20e`". `KB_search("crack within tolerance reinspection charge")` returns it.
- P3's documents carry no prerequisite sentence -> tree ends.
- Weight: P3's write moves P2's non-warranty-visit tier from 1.25 to 1.50 (40.83 -> 48.99). P2's write does not change any input of P1's figure as far as the visible factor rules show (no systems-settlement factor reads dispatch charges); P1 -> P2 bears weight as a hard gate ("is not offered ... until"), not through the number.

Factor findability from the records' own words: `no_cooling` -> Emergency Condition Classes ("no cooling emergency dispatch" 1st); `maintenance_item` -> Inspection Findings and the Emergency Dispatch Charge (1st for "clogged filter maintenance item dispatch") and Maintenance Record of the Home in Systems Settlements; `response_hours` -> Response-Time Proration (1st); Homesite Reservation `held` + `reservation_deposit` -> Active Buyer Rates (1st for "homesite reservation hold deposit warranty", the doc names "Homesite Reservation" and "reservation deposit received on the homeowner's homesite ledger"); `measured_width_in` / `concrete_flatwork` / `Sierra Vista Ranch` -> Borderline, Soil Movement; filing vs inspection dates -> Re-Measure Delay; same-day `defect_confirmed` inspection -> Shared Visit; `contract_price` -> Home-Scale Rates (1st); `Sierra Vista Ranch` -> Community Market Rates (1st); `hvac` -> Systems Trade Rates (1st); `systems_end_date` -> Remaining Systems Coverage (1st); callback approvals -> Repeated System Failures. No factor was reachable only through a computation document; the three worksheets name no variation.

- Alternative home-scale price (base price 689990 -> 1.10): excluded by "contract price on the home's Home Purchase Agreement".
- Alternative active-buyer tier 0.50: excluded — the only Home Purchase Agreement is `closed`.
- Alternative dispatch proration (whole charge or none): 15.5 h is "longer than the program's emergency response hours but not more than twice them".
- Alternative order P2 before P3: excluded by "The dispatch charge is fixed only after ..."; it would give 40.83.
- "Do only the one thing the customer asked" (acceptance only): excluded by the systems hub's gate "is not offered ... and no cash-in-lieu payout is approved on it, until every emergency dispatch ... carries its emergency dispatch charge" while the 2026-09-19 dispatch is uncharged.
- Fall-backs: reinspection 100.00, dispatch 125.00, systems 400.00 — each definite and different from 25.20 / 48.99 / 886.10.
